newsitem.title: POLAND: Espebepe hopes for debt write-off deal.
newsitem.headline: Espebepe hopes for debt write-off deal.

text.p: Polish construction company Espebepe SA hopes its creditors will clinch a debt write-off deal, necessary to save the firm from bankruptcy, during their meeting on March 14, the company's president said on Friday.
Andrzej Hass said some of the firm's 18 large creditors, to which the company owes 70 percent of its 80-million-zloty debt, had already signalled they were likely to agree for the write-off.

"I believe it will end up with success... Large creditors are likely to agree as well as small ones, but talks are not easy..., as convincing medium-size creditors is difficult," Andrzej Hass told Reuters.
The firm, which reported a 52.1 million zloty loss in 1996, wants its biggest creditors to write off about 90 percent of the debts and requests that smaller creditors write off about 20 percent.
The company has said it will launch a restructuring programme after after its creditors agree on the deal, without which it will face bankruptcy.
